description: Phase 2b gate — VDBE-specific behaviour. Exercises the compiler and vdbe parts DIRECTLY (not via the executor), proving both parts exist with well-formed public entries. Every compiled program must also satisfy the well-formedness invariants in spec/vdbe-opcodes.spec.md § 'Well-formedness' — the harness verifies them per compiled program before running. Phase 2b also relies on tests/cross-build/phase2a.json remaining green via the updated executor; phase2a.json is the full behavioural regression.

cases.name: select-star-empty-table-vdbe
cases.description: Empty table — tests OpRewind jump_if_empty short-circuit.

cases.name: select-star-multi-row-vdbe
cases.description: Multi-row table — tests OpNext back-edge loop.

cases.name: select-star-multi-column-vdbe
cases.description: Multi-column star SELECT — tests multiple OpColumn emissions per row.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b TEXT, c INTEGER);

cases.name: select-reordered-projection-vdbe
cases.description: Reordered projection — tests OpColumn with non-identity column indices.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b TEXT);

cases.name: compile-time-unknown-column-in-select
cases.description: Phase 2b raises STORAGE_COLUMN_NOT_FOUND at compile time for SELECT, not at execution.

cases.name: compile-time-unknown-column-in-insert-list
cases.description: Phase 2b raises STORAGE_COLUMN_NOT_FOUND at compile time for INSERT with column list referencing unknown column.

cases.name: compile-time-missing-table-in-select
cases.description: SELECT from a non-existent table raises STORAGE_TABLE_NOT_FOUND at compile time.

cases.name: select-literal-vdbe
cases.description: SelectLiteral compiles to a zero-cursor LoadConst + ResultRow + Halt program.

cases.name: insert-column-list-reordering-vdbe
cases.description: INSERT with reordered column list — tests column-name resolution during InsertRow.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b TEXT);

cases.name: insert-type-mismatch-runtime-vdbe
cases.description: Type mismatch is raised by OpInsertRow at VDBE runtime (not at compile time — values are compiler-opaque).

cases.name: many-inserts-then-select-preserves-order
cases.description: Cursor write → read sequencing preserves insertion order across many rows.

cases.name: duplicated-projection-columns-vdbe
cases.description: SELECT a, a FROM t duplicates the column. Compiler must emit two OpColumn opcodes with the same column index.

program.sql: SELECT a, a, a FROM t;

cases.name: compile-time-duplicate-column-in-insert-list
cases.description: Phase 2b raises STORAGE_DUPLICATE_COLUMN at compile time for INSERT with a duplicated column name.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);

cases.name: create-table-vdbe
cases.description: CREATE TABLE compiles to a zero-cursor, zero-register program.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE multi (a INTEGER, b TEXT, c INTEGER);

cases.name: create-table-already-exists-vdbe
cases.description: STORAGE_TABLE_EXISTS raised by OpCreateTable at runtime (compiler does not pre-check).
